Synthetic NEM12 samples. The NMI and serial are made up. Never commit a real readings file.

- `sample-nem12.csv`: the layout of a real distributor export (no 100/900 records, a V day with 400 events, a missing date, last line without its trailing field), with an E1 consumption and a B1 export stream.
- Larger files are built in tests by `test/energy/nem12-fixture.ts`.
